PagerDuty: INCIDENT: p99 latency breach on streaming endpoints in prod (us-west-2). alert: https://dash.internal/alerts/INC-1772. paging @sre-oncall

PagerDuty: paging @sre-oncall for p99 latency SLO breach and streaming stalls.

Alex K.: oncall here, looking. taking lead. seeing big p95/p99 spike for realtime-stream API.

Morgan L.: I can confirm. p95 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.2s, p99 from ~1.8s to ~6.4s. streaming_stall_rate metric up from 0.4% -> 4.3%.

Casey R.: logs show batch-scheduler queue depth growing on the continuous-batching path. a lot of large mixed-length batches around the same timestamps. suspect KV cache thrash + scheduling starvation.

Alex K.: ok immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) disable continuous batching for streaming endpoints, 2) cap max_batch_size to 8, 3) enable scheduling fairness (prefer homogeneous batches), 4) temporarily throttle very long sequences (>2k tokens).

Casey R.: runbook commands (prod):
```
# toggle continuous batching off for inference runtime
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/inference-runtime CONT_BATCHING_ENABLED=false
# cap max batch size for scheduler
kubectl -n prod set env deployment/batch-scheduler MAX_BATCH_SIZE=8
# flip fairness flag via control plane
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" -d '{"prefer_homogeneous_batches":true}'
```

SRE-Bot: rollout started for deployment/inference-runtime (rev: v2026.03.14-1258). rolling update 1/20 -> 20/20 pods.

Ewa P.: applying to us-west-2 first, then replicate to other regions. prepping customer comms for any sustained impact.

(about 10m later)

SRE-Bot: rollout complete for inference-runtime. health: 20/20 pods ready.

Alex K.: after disabling continuous batching and capping batch size, observed p99 drop to ~1.3s within 10 minutes, stall_rate down to ~0.6%. trending stable.

Morgan L.: digging into traces: large batches (>=16) mixing short (<=64 tokens) + very long sequences (>1500 tokens) caused per-request latency amplification. KV cache thrash + longer CPU/GPU kernel execs held schedulers open. fairness flag should help by grouping similar-length requests.

Casey R.: follow-ups we should do before re-enabling continuous batching broadly:
- add batch-size-distribution metric and alert when % of >12 batches rises above threshold
- implement homogeneous bucketing in the scheduler (by token-length bin)
- consider adaptive max_batch_size per model/sequence-length profile
- add synthetic mixed-seq load tests to CI

Tariq: assigning postmortem to Casey R. and Morgan L. Can you own RCA and remediation plan? ETA EOD for draft.

Ewa P.: customer impact summary: 4 enterprise tenants (internal IDs 231, 402, 511, 622) reported elevated tail latency; 2 tenants reported aborted streams/timeouts. CS notified and offered credits. logged in incidents tracker.

Alex K.: handing off active follow-ups to Morgan for the next 4 hours. Morgan, please keep an eye on regressions and the controlled canary for re-enabling continuous batching with the new policies.

Morgan L.: taking over. I'll run a canary against a mixed-sequence synthetic load and validate prefer_homogeneous_batches=true + MAX_BATCH_SIZE=8. will post results to this thread.

Alex K.: thanks everyone. closing pager for now — mitigation in place. :white_check_mark:

PagerDuty: INCIDENT status updated: mitigated (temporary config change). please continue follow-ups in-thread and file postmortem when ready.
